description:
Keyword/code search over the Combined Nomenclature (or PRODCOM).

Returns ranked `{code, label, path}` candidates. Prefer
`resolve_product_code` for a one-call keyword-or-code helper; use this
directly if you specifically want the raw ranked candidate list.

lang.description: Language for translated labels in the response; any other language is refused.

limit.description: Max number of candidates to return.

q.description: Keyword or code fragment to search for.

source.description: Nomenclature to search. A dotted PRODCOM code (e.g. '23.13') is auto-detected either way and reverse-mapped to CN codes.

name: search_customs_codes

result.description:
GET /api/reference/search — ranked candidates; ``matched_prodcom`` is
set when the query was a dotted PRODCOM notation.

anyOf.description: The PRODCOM code resolved from a dotted search query.

description.description: The code's label, when the nomenclature lists one.

prodcom_code.description: The resolved PRODCOM code, in dotted form.

matched_prodcom.description: The resolved PRODCOM code descriptor, when the query used PRODCOM notation (present even when no CN code maps).

label.description: The code's label, in the requested language; null for a mapped code the nomenclature does not list.

path.description: The candidate's breadcrumb: its ancestor labels joined into one string; null alongside a null label.

via_prodcom.description: The dotted PRODCOM form the match came through, for PRODCOM-notation queries.

source.description: The nomenclature searched ('cn', or 'prodcom' for PRODCOM-notation queries).

title: Search Customs Codes
